messages:
alex: quick heads-up — opened PR #4821 to add soft-routing fallback for overloaded models. Per process this is gated on the architecture RFC so we need arch sign-off before merge. RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/2025-07-model-fallbacks — PTAL when you have a moment

morgan: thanks for the ping. PR link?

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 — branch: feature/fallback-routing. CI queued, unit tests included.

priya: will do an initial pass today. one quick Q: any DB/schema changes?

alex: no DB changes — just routing policy + in-memory policy cache. added unit test for policy selection.

kyle: tagging arch reviewers: @maria @jordan — RFC looks linked, fyi the customer with the burst is on Tuesday, so sooner is better.

maria: skimmed the RFC earlier. left a comment on the compatibility section (section 3) about deterministic fallback ordering. i'll do a full read and the arch review after lunch.

alex: thanks — pushed a follow-up commit to explicitly document deterministic ordering and to add a small KV cache invalidation step.

ops-bot: note: PR #4821 is currently BLOCKED by label 'arch-approved' per repository rules.

jordan: I can take a deep review tomorrow morning (09:00 PT). if the PR addresses maria's comment and tests stay green, can we plan to merge by EOD tomorrow? customer needs elevated throughput as of Wed.

alex: EOD SGTM. also requesting an infra code reviewer for the concurrency changes — @sam can you review that part?

sam: I can review the concurrency/locking bits later today. will call out anything risky.

morgan: small nit: prefer FeatureFlag.v2 over toggle string, left inline comment in PR.

alex: thanks — updated to FeatureFlag.v2 in the branch.

priya: approved the PR from a correctness standpoint (non-arch parts). :thumbsup:

sam: reviewed concurrency section, left one suggestion for a slightly smaller critical section; otherwise approved.

maria: confirmed the deterministic ordering change looks good, left one stylistic comment but nothing blocking. arch-approved.

jordan: adding 'arch-approved' label now. planning to merge at 16:00 PT tomorrow if CI stays green and no regressions on canary.

alex: awesome, thanks everyone — will watch the canary rollout after merge and be on-call for the evening. :rocket:
